blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Labor group Sentro ng mga Nagkakaisa at Progresibong Manggagawa (SENTRO) called for decent jobs and higher wages amid improvements in the country’s labor market in August. The August Labor Force Survey (LFS) showed the number of employed Filipinos rising from 49.21 million in July to 49.79 million in August, while unemployment declined from 6 percent to 5.3 percent and underemployment fell from 12.9 percent to 11.9 percent. “Far from healthy” SENTRO welcomed the gains but said the country’s jobs situation remained “far from healthy,” pointing to the composition of the employment increase and the decline in working hours.
